title.zh: 2026 咨询行业观察：AI 项目占比过半意味着什么
title.en: Consulting in 2026: what it means that AI projects are now the majority

summary.zh: 从项目类型、人员结构、招聘口径三个角度看这一年 MBB 的变化，以及对应届生的具体影响。
summary.en: How MBB changed this year in project mix, staffing and hiring criteria — and what it means for new grads.

body.zh:
过去一年，我所在办公室超过一半的项目和 AI 落地有关。这带来三个变化：

第一，项目周期更短，客户更看重两周内能看到的原型。

第二，团队里开始固定配一名有工程背景的顾问，非商科背景反而成了加分项。

第三，校招面试里开始出现「你会怎么用 AI 解决这个 case」这类问题。建议准备两三个自己真的用过 AI 工具做分析的例子。
body.en:
Over the past year, more than half of my office's projects involved AI deployment. Three things changed:

First, engagements got shorter; clients want a prototype within two weeks.

Second, teams now routinely include a consultant with an engineering background — a non-business major is an asset.

Third, campus interviews now ask 'how would you use AI on this case'. Prepare two or three real examples of using AI tools for analysis.

title.zh: 拿到 Google 校招 offer 的完整时间线（含内推细节）
title.en: My full Google new-grad timeline, referral details included

summary.zh: 从 8 月投递到 11 月 offer 的每一步，以及内推到底能帮到哪一步。
summary.en: Every step from an August application to a November offer, and exactly what the referral did.

body.zh:
8 月 12 日校友内推，8 月 15 日收到 OA，8 月 20 日完成。9 月 3 日电面，10 月 1 日 virtual onsite（4 轮），10 月 20 日 team match，11 月 5 日 offer。

内推的作用：跳过简历筛选，直接进 OA。之后的每一轮都只看表现。

最有用的准备：每周两次 mock，找不同的人练，尤其是行为面。
body.en:
Aug 12 alumni referral, Aug 15 OA received, Aug 20 completed. Sep 3 phone screen, Oct 1 virtual onsite (4 rounds), Oct 20 team match, Nov 5 offer.

What the referral did: skip the resume screen straight to the OA. Every round after that is on you.

Most useful prep: two mocks a week with different people, especially behavioral.

title.zh: 简历修改案例：从「做过」到「做成了什么」

summary.zh: 一份投行申请简历的三轮修改记录，重点是量化与动词。
summary.en: Three rounds of edits on an IB application resume, focused on quantification and verbs.

body.zh:
原句：负责协助团队完成一个并购项目的财务分析。

第一轮：为一笔 5 亿美元的跨境并购搭建三张表模型。

第二轮：独立搭建三张表与 DCF 模型，支持 5 亿美元跨境并购的估值区间讨论，模型被合伙人用于客户汇报。

每一条经历都问自己：数字是什么？结果被谁用了？
body.en:
Original: Assisted the team in completing financial analysis for an M&A project.

Round one: Built a three-statement model for a $500M cross-border acquisition.

Round two: Independently built the three-statement and DCF models supporting the valuation range for a $500M cross-border acquisition; the partner used the model in the client presentation.

For every bullet ask: what's the number, and who used the result?

title.zh: 海外应届回国秋招：我踩过的五个坑
title.en: Returning to China for campus recruiting: five mistakes I made

summary.zh: 应届身份认定、时差笔试、国内简历格式、三方协议、薪资谈判。
summary.en: Fresh-grad status, time-zone tests, China resume format, tripartite agreements, salary negotiation.

body.zh:
1. 应届身份：毕业时间和留服认证决定你能不能投「2027 届」。提前问 HR。

2. 笔试时间：国内周六晚八点等于美东周六早八点，别错过。

3. 简历格式：一页、有照片、写明预计毕业时间。

4. 三方协议：海外院校通常没有，用 offer letter 即可，但要看违约金条款。

5. 谈薪：国内 offer 常有「总包」口径，问清楚现金部分。
body.en:
1. Fresh-grad status: your graduation date and credential authentication decide whether you count as 'class of 2027'. Ask HR early.

2. Test timing: 8 pm Saturday in Beijing is 8 am Saturday on the US East Coast.

3. Resume: one page, photo, expected graduation date.

4. Tripartite agreement: overseas schools usually don't have one; an offer letter works, but read the breach clause.

5. Negotiation: China offers quote 'total package' — pin down the cash portion.

title.zh: 量化面试到底在考什么
title.en: What quant interviews are really testing

summary.zh: 概率题只是表面，面试官在看你的思考过程与承认错误的速度。
summary.en: Probability puzzles are the surface; interviewers watch how you reason and how fast you admit a mistake.

body.zh:
做了两年面试官后的观察：

答对题的人很多，但被录取的人有一个共同点——他们会把思路说出来，被指出错误时立刻改，而不是辩解。

准备建议：每道题练习「出声思考」，录音回听。
body.en:
After two years on the interviewer side:

Many candidates get the answer; the ones who get hired share one trait — they think out loud and correct immediately when wrong, instead of defending.

Prep tip: practice every problem by talking through it, record yourself, listen back.

title.zh: 从 Tsai CITY 到上海：一个校友创业项目的真实账本
title.en: From Tsai CITY to Shanghai: an honest ledger of an alumni startup

summary.zh: 孵化期拿到了什么、回国第一年花了多少钱、哪些资源真的有用。
summary.en: What incubation actually provided, what year one in China cost, and which resources mattered.

body.zh:
Tsai CITY 给的最有价值的不是钱，是每周一次的 mentor office hour 和第一批愿意试用的用户。

回国第一年：注册与合规约 3 万元，人力是大头。留学人员创业园减免了一年租金。

最有用的资源：校友投资人的第一轮反馈，帮我们砍掉了两个功能。
body.en:
The most valuable thing from Tsai CITY wasn't money — it was weekly mentor office hours and the first users willing to try.

Year one in China: about ¥30k on registration and compliance; people were the big cost. The returnee park waived a year of rent.

Most useful resource: first-round feedback from alumni investors, which killed two features.

title.zh: 2026 秋季学期职业发展部计划与招募
title.en: Career Development: Fall 2026 plan and call for volunteers

summary.zh: 本学期将做：校招信息周报、四个行业求职小组、两场校友分享会。招募 6 名志愿者。
summary.en: This semester: weekly recruiting digest, four industry study groups, two alumni panels. Recruiting six volunteers.

body.zh:
计划：

· 每周一发布校招信息周报（本站「机会 & 内推」同步）
· 咨询 / 科技 / 量化 / 数据四个求职小组
· 9 月咨询分享会、10 月科技分享会

招募：信息整理 2 人、活动执行 2 人、小组协调 2 人。有意者在本帖留言或直接找我。
body.en:
Plan:

· Weekly recruiting digest every Monday (mirrored in Jobs & Referrals here)
· Four study groups: consulting / tech / quant / data
· Consulting panel in September, tech panel in October

Volunteers: 2 for digest, 2 for events, 2 for group coordination. Comment here or message me.

title.zh: 博士转工业界：我怎么把论文写成产品经历
title.en: PhD to industry: rewriting a thesis as product experience

summary.zh: 招聘经理不关心你的 h-index，关心你解决过什么问题、多快、和谁一起。
summary.en: Hiring managers don't care about your h-index; they care what problem you solved, how fast, and with whom.

body.zh:
把每个课题拆成：问题 → 方法 → 结果 → 影响。去掉术语，加上时间与协作方。

例如：「优化了 mRNA 递送效率」改成「在 6 个月内把递送效率提高 40%，与两个合作实验室共同验证，结果进入公司立项评审」。
body.en:
Break every project into problem → method → result → impact. Drop jargon; add timing and collaborators.

E.g. 'optimized mRNA delivery efficiency' becomes 'raised delivery efficiency 40% in six months, validated with two partner labs; results entered the company's project review'.

title.zh: 湾区新人第一个月：租房、车、信用卡的顺序
title.en: First month in the Bay Area: housing, car and credit card, in that order

summary.zh: 先短租再长租，先买车再选长租地点，信用卡第一周就办。
summary.en: Short-term rental first, buy the car before choosing a long-term place, and get the credit card in week one.

body.zh:
顺序很重要：

1. 落地先住一个月短租，别急着签一年。
2. 有车之后通勤半径完全不同，再决定住哪儿。
3. 信用卡第一周就申请，信用记录越早开始越好。
body.en:
Order matters:

1. Take a one-month rental on arrival; don't sign a year-long lease yet.
2. A car changes your commute radius entirely — decide where to live after.
3. Apply for a credit card in week one; credit history starts the sooner the better.

title.zh: 早期投资人怎么看校友项目：三个必答问题
title.en: How an early-stage investor reads an alumni project: three must-answer questions

summary.zh: 为什么是你、为什么是现在、第一批用户从哪来。
summary.en: Why you, why now, and where the first users come from.

body.zh:
我看过的校友 deck 里，最常缺的是「为什么是现在」。技术变化、政策变化或用户习惯变化，至少要有一条。

发我 one-pager 就好，别一上来发 30 页。
body.en:
The question most alumni decks skip is 'why now'. Name at least one shift — technology, policy or user behavior.

Send a one-pager; don't open with 30 slides.

title.zh: 在英国找数据岗位：签证担保公司怎么查
title.en: Data jobs in the UK: how to check visa sponsorship

summary.zh: 政府担保公司名单的用法、薪资门槛、以及哪些公司对毕业生签证友好。
summary.en: Using the government's sponsor register, salary thresholds, and which firms are graduate-visa friendly.

body.zh: 先在政府公开的 sponsor 名单里查公司，再投。Graduate Visa 期间入职的公司不一定担保，面试时直接问。
body.en: Check the public sponsor register before applying. A company that hires you on a Graduate Visa won't necessarily sponsor later — ask in the interview.

title.zh: 教职市场：job talk 彩排清单
title.en: Faculty market: a job-talk rehearsal checklist

summary.zh: 前 3 分钟、问答环节、给非本领域听众的部分，三块各需要单独练。
summary.en: The first three minutes, Q&A, and the section for non-specialists each need separate rehearsal.

body.zh:
至少彩排三次：一次给同领域同学，一次给不同领域校友，一次录像自己看。

问答最难的不是专业问题，是「这个方向五年后在哪里」。
body.en:
Rehearse at least three times: once for peers in your field, once for alumni outside it, once on video for yourself.

The hardest Q&A isn't technical — it's 'where is this line of work in five years'.

title.zh: 校友创业最常见的三个法律问题
title.en: Three legal questions alumni founders ask most

summary.zh: 股权怎么分、学校 IP 归谁、中美两地主体怎么搭。
summary.en: Splitting equity, who owns university IP, and structuring US–China entities.

body.zh:
非正式意见：

1. 股权分配一定要有 vesting。
2. 用了学校资源的成果先问 Yale Ventures。
3. 两地主体优先考虑一个控股公司，别一开始就双主体运营。
body.en:
Informal view:

1. Always vest founder equity.
2. Anything built with university resources — ask Yale Ventures first.
3. For US–China, prefer one holding company; don't run two operating entities from day one.

title.zh: 本科生第一份实习简历：没有经历怎么写
title.en: A first internship resume with no experience

summary.zh: 课程项目、社团、竞赛也能写成成果，关键是数字和动词。
summary.en: Class projects, clubs and competitions count — just use numbers and verbs.

body.zh:
把「参与了学联中秋晚会」写成「协调 20 名志愿者完成 300 人晚会执行，负责流程与物资，零事故」。

没有数字就去数：多少人、多长时间、多少次。
body.en:
Turn 'participated in the ACSSY gala' into 'coordinated 20 volunteers for a 300-guest gala, owning run-of-show and logistics, zero incidents'.

No numbers? Go count: how many people, how long, how many times.
